scripts.start: AGENTS=${AGENTS:-2} BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(get-port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(get-port) npm run network
scripts.start:tauri: AGENTS=${AGENTS:-2} BOOTSTRAP_PORT=$(get-port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(get-port) npm run network:tauri
scripts.start:hwc: npm run build:happ && concurrently --kill-others "./deploy/local-dev.sh" "npm run start --workspace ui"
scripts.start:hwc:joining: npm run build:happ && concurrently --kill-others "./deploy/local-dev.sh joining" "JOINING_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:3000/v1 npm run start --workspace ui"
scripts.network: hc sandbox clean && npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=1420 concurrently "npm run start --workspace ui" "npm run launch:spin" "hc playground"
scripts.network:tauri: hc sandbox clean && npm run build:happ && UI_PORT=1420 concurrently "npm run start --workspace ui" "npm run launch:tauri" "hc playground"
scripts.launch:tauri: concurrently "hc run-local-services --bootstrap-port $BOOTSTRAP_PORT --signal-port $SIGNAL_PORT" "echo pass | WEBKIT_DISABLE_COMPOSITING_MODE=1 RUST_LOG=warn hc launch --piped -n $AGENTS workdir/mewsfeed.happ --ui-port $UI_PORT network --bootstrap http://127.0.0.1:"$BOOTSTRAP_PORT" webrtc ws://127.0.0.1:"$SIGNAL_PORT""
scripts.package: npm run build:happ && npm run package --workspace ui && hc web-app pack workdir --recursive
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:zomes && hc app pack workdir --recursive && hc app pack workdir-no-limits --recursive
scripts.test: npm run build:happ && npm t -w tests
